parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, cylindrical in shape, and used to control water flow.
parts.Functional_description: It regulates the water flow and temperature by rotating to open or close the valve.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to adjust the water flow.

parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, similar to the right handle, used for controlling water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It controls either hot or cold water flow depending on the plumbing configuration.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the water valve.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or frame of the faucet, made of brass, connecting the spout and switches to the water supply.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the structural base that channels water from the inlet pipes to the spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides support for other moving parts.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, curved in shape, and responsible for directing water flow.
parts.Functional_description: It delivers water from the faucet body to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water flow in different directions.
